system.description:
Whenever it wishes, a draugr can transform into an animal, often a wolf, raven, or horse. This is how it travels for longer distances.

It takes the draugr 3 action rounds to change shape. During these rounds, the draugr cannot defend itself in any way. Therefore, it is unlikely to change shape when enemies pose a threat.

Each transformation costs 30 days and nights of the draugr’s remaining stay.
